theorem lg_target {y z : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hzy : z ≤ y) : ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iic y, f x = (∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Iio z, f x) + ∫⁻ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc z y, f x := by
  have h : Set.Iic y = Set.Iio z ∪ Set.Icc z y := by
    rw [Set.Iic_eq_Iio_union_Icc]
  rw [h, integral_add]
  exact measure_theory.integral_additive (measure_theory.measure_dirac f) (measure_theory.measure_dirac f) (measure_theory.measure_dirac f)
